currentRuntime.preserveUntil: Herdr passes live Termux compatibility, persistence, detach/reattach, agent-state, and sprint evidence gates

promotionRule: Do not replace tmux in the canonical Android runtime until every gate has same-device evidence and the existing Android runtime validators remain green.
forbidden: automatic Android device_config or battery-policy mutation
claiming Linux aarch64 binary compatibility proves Android/Termux compatibility
claiming command presence proves background persistence
persisting credentials or device codes in evidence
proofCeiling: Repository contracts can prove migration policy, probe behavior, and validation wiring. They do not prove Herdr runs correctly on Android/Termux or survives Android background process management.
